summary: One church. The Mass, confession and 24-hour Adoration times are the same in the schedule box of both bulletins (Nov 8 and Nov 15) and on the website; a weekly Wednesday 7 PM Mass with the Perpetual Help novena comes from both weeks' intentions and the website. Day-of-month devotions (19th, 23rd) can't be expressed and are left out apart from the dated Nov 23 Padre Pio Mass; the second-Monday Mass after the Rosary has no definite time. No open questions.
